title: Kineviz demo manifest (Spanner Omni)
description: Runbook and index metadata for one demo. Validated by tools/check_contract.py.

slug.description: Must equal the demo's directory name.

status.description: Spanner Omni is itself pre-GA, so every demo here is at most 'preview'. pending-upstream = blocked on a capability that has not shipped.

maturity_note.description: Required when status is not 'stable'. Surfaced in the README and by preflight.

last_verified.description: Last date a human ran this end to end. CI warns past 120 days.

omni_version.description: The Spanner Omni image tag it was verified against, e.g. 2026.r1-beta.2

connection.description: How Kineviz reaches the graph. Omni is not reachable by the native Spanner connector today — see connect/README.md.

bounded_by.description: How spend is capped. For Omni this is usually 'nothing is billable — it runs on your own hardware', which must still be stated rather than left blank.

billable_resources.description: Empty for a purely local deployment. Non-empty if the demo provisions a VM, a managed cluster, or anything else metered.

local_resources.description: What the demo consumes on the machine it runs on. Omni's equivalent of a cloud bill.

inputs.description: Values the agent must collect from the person. Never invented.

python.description: Python distributions the demo needs, e.g. google-cloud-spanner>=3.65.0. Installed by './gxr deps', never silently.

omni_version.description: Minimum Spanner Omni image tag known to work.

kineviz_desktop.description: Floor, not an exact pin. Bumped by .github/workflows/desktop-floor.yml

kineviz_account.description: true = the person must sign in themselves. The agent never does.

creates.description: Exactly what teardown must remove. Nothing else.

upstream.description: Set when a demo orchestrates a pipeline living in another repo rather than owning the code. Pin the commit — an unpinned upstream is how a demo silently stops working.

commit.description: Full SHA. A branch name is not a pin.
